notes: DeepSeek Harness is a conversation-fork variant. The original stable session runs two turns. The official web session controller then creates a fresh seeded session from a completed-turn prefix, with parentSession pointing to the original. The DSH adapter watches the new compressed transcript and can emit its ready state plus a clean post-fork ready-to-working-to-ready arc. The adapter does not expose parentSession as dashboard lineage, so the machine-checkable lifecycle uses a distinct new row while transcript assertions prove that the row is a real seeded fork rather than /clear or an unrelated session. min_delay_ms skips any inherited-prefix lifecycle events replayed when the child transcript is first tailed.
